name: Lvl1
source:
Created for [url=http://vk.com/microreno2]MicroReno 2014[/url].

Igor thought he was going to have a boring day, but when his mother told him to go buy some groceries he ended somehow in a game world! All he needs to do in order to escape is to spend 24 hours without losing all of his 3 lives.
translation:
本作参加了[url=http://vk.com/microreno2]MicroReno 2014[/url]。

伊戈尔原以为今天会无聊地度过，但母亲叫他去买杂货后，他不知怎么就进入了游戏世界！他想要逃出去，只需在不耗尽3条命的情况下度过24小时。
